::: {#def-data-generating-process}
#### Data-generating process

The **data-generating process (DGP)** of a simulation
is the joint [probability distribution](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-random-variable) $F_{\param_0}$
from which it draws its data $\dsn{X}$,
with the sample size $n$ and the parameter value $\param_0$ fixed and known:

$$\dsn{X} \sim F_{\param_0}.$$
:::
